name: Starlight Cove
storyline:
Make some lemonade and set sail in this cozy fishing incremental game. Catch weird fish across colorful locations, upgrade your gear, rebuild Starlight Cove back to its former glory, and defeat the evil shark that stole your grandfather’s greatest treasure years ago.

Set sail across the shores of Starlight Cove. In this cozy incremental game, join your grandfather for a summer you won’t forget.

Catch fish, upgrade your skills, rebuild your little town and help its townsfolk reach new heights.

The more fish you catch the more money you make, the more money you make means more upgrades to buy, more upgrades equal more fish!

Spend your hard-earned cash on skills, island upgrades and cosmetics.

Keep the fish you catch in your local aquarium for everyone to enjoy.

Along the way uncover a heartfelt story about you, your grandfather and the townsfolk of Starlight Cove.
